title: Resolving Sweep Error ERR-7741
body_md:
# Resolving Sweep Error ERR-7741

## Symptom

A recurring payment sweep aborts and the journal shows code ERR-7741.

## Cause

The nostro account mapping is missing for the settlement currency.

## Fix

1. Open Administration > Nostro Mapping.
2. Add a mapping for the affected currency.
3. Re-run the sweep batch.
